evals.prompt: Operating mode is active and Beads is initialized. I kicked off unit 'load 3MF with boundary errors'. Claim the matching open bead if it exists, otherwise create a task and claim it. Then run the unit to PR. Do not close anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Claims or creates+claims exactly one unit bead, then continues operating-mode to a feature-branch PR without closing or publishing beads.
expectations: Uses bd where or equivalent only as needed and works in an initialized workspace.
Claims at most one bead for the unit (update --claim or create then claim).
Does not close the bead, run multi-unit claim-next, or dolt push.
Treats the PR as the unit delivery goal under operating-mode.

evals.prompt: While implementing the current unit bd-12, I found we will need export validation later. Park that work in Beads and keep going on bd-12 only.
evals.expected_output: Creates a parked issue for the discovery and continues the current unit without implementing the parked work.
expectations: Creates a new task (or equivalent) for the discovered work.
Does not claim or implement the new issue in this unit.
Does not close bd-12 or start a second unit.

evals.prompt: PR #18 for unit bd-12 merged and I understand the diff. Close the bead.
evals.expected_output: Closes bd-12 with a reason tied to the merge; no source git operations and no next-unit auto-claim.
expectations: Runs bd close on bd-12 with a reason.
Does not invent labels, epics, or follow-up claims.
Does not git commit/push or dolt push unless separately requested.

evals.prompt: Use Beads to finish the whole slicer product tonight: load, UI, and export as one agent session.
evals.expected_output: Refuses multi-unit oneshot; keeps operating-mode one-unit discipline; beads may hold backlog but not authorize multi-feature unattended work.
expectations: Points at one unit at a time with PR review between units.
Does not treat bd ready or claim-next as permission to oneshot the product.
